content:
maya (product): Quick sync — we need an operationalized plan for KMS/BYOK + audit/retention for enterprise customers. Q3 ship target. Primary questions: tenant opt-in, rotation rehearsal, exportable evidence, SOC2 mapping.

jin (eng-runtime): What do we consider the minimal acceptance criteria for an initial GA?

maya (product): Minimal GA I think: 1) tenant-level key handshake (create/confirm), 2) rotation API + rollback path, 3) configurable retention TTL per-tenant visible in Console, 4) one-click export of evidence (signed), 5) runbook for SRE + test rehearsal.

priya (eng-sre): SRE must have an oncall playbook and runbook before GA. Paging thresholds for key failures and evidence export failures. Also need a reconciliation job to detect mismatched key states across regions.

carlos (security): Security asks: HSM-backed KEK support, proof-of-rotation artifacts (signed attestations), and KMS escrow process documented with access controls. SOC2 auditors will expect chain-of-custody for keys and logs.

zoe (customer-success): Customers will ask for a migration window and a tenant opt-in toggle. They want a dry-run mode so we can simulate handshake without cutting traffic. Pilot customers: Acme and Nova.

maya (product): Proposed launch gates (rough):
```csv
Gate,Owner,Acceptance
KMS API parity,eng-runtime,handshake/rotate/status endpoints + unit tests
Keystore rotation rehearsal,eng-sre,successful dry-run with pilot tenant + post-checks
Tenant retention config,product + console,per-tenant TTL + UI + docs
Evidence export,security + product,export zip with signed manifest + 2-hour SLA
SOC2 control mapping,security,control doc + sample evidence for 5 controls
```

jin (eng-runtime): For API parity we can stub the escrow parts initially and mark as gated for enterprise-only feature flag. Will need integration tests that exercise rollback.

priya (eng-sre): Rehearsal checklist draft:
- schedule dry-run with pilot tenant (Acme)
- run `keystore-rehearsal --simulate-rotate --tenant=acme`
- validate token issuance and KV cache invalidation
- export evidence and confirm signature and manifest
- run post-rotate perf smoke (qps and p95)

maya (product): Adding deploy-bot note: @deploy-bot will create a rehearsal environment tag and automated runbook link.

deploy-bot: rehearsal environment created: env=keystore-rehearsal-2024-07-10. Link: https://console/rehearsals/keystore-rehearsal-2024-07-10

carlos (security): On evidence export: include: key id, rotation timestamp, signed attestations, requester identity, and HTTP trace id for request. Retention for exported artifacts should be configurable.

zoe (customer-success): UX ask: Console should show a simple "BYOK status" with last rotation, next scheduled rotation (if auto), and a single export button. Non-admin users should see redacted views.

maya (product): Decision proposals: default retention = 90 days for hosted. Enterprise tier (Dedicated/Private) can request 365+ with contract. Export SLA = 2 hours for GA. Rehearsal pilot required before enabling for customer.

jin (eng-runtime): +1 on gated enterprise opt-in. We should add a fallback model: if KMS unavailable, route to a warmed ephemeral keyholder and emit a high-severity metric.

priya (eng-sre): Metric names suggested:
- `keystore.rotate.failure`
- `keystore.handshake.latency`
- `evidence.export.duration`
- `evidence.export.failure`

maya (product): Action items (owners):
- jin: API parity sprint + integration tests (due 2024-06-30)
- priya: rehearshal runbook + automation (due 2024-07-05)
- carlos: SOC2 mapping doc + evidence spec (due 2024-06-20)
- zoe: pilot customer coordination (Acme) (due 2024-07-01)
- maya: retention policy doc + pricing note (due 2024-06-25)

carlos (security): Also flag legal about export retention policy and data subject requests (we may need legal hold exceptions).

zoe (customer-success): I'll start cadence with Acme - propose rehearsal week of July 8.

maya (product): Good. I'll slot a follow-up on Mon 2024-06-17 10:30 for gate review. Please update the checklist PR: https://git/repo/keystore-gates PR#42

jin (eng-runtime): will open PR for API stubs today.

priya (eng-sre): adding a postmortem template to the runbook in case a rotation causes incidents.

zoe (customer-success): Will collect initial customer legal & compliance questions and add to the doc.

maya (product): Thanks — aim is to have a rehearsal and an explicit go/no-go checklist before enabling tenant opt-in. :white_check_mark:

jin (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled: rehearsal-job/keystore-rehearsal-2024-07-10 -> status=scheduled

zoe (customer-success): I'll coordinate pilot customer (Acme) for July 10 rehearsal.
